title: Standard-Name documentation-campaign manifest
description: The approve-before-you-spend record for a documentation-refinement campaign: the defect-predicate spec that selected the names, the totals and per-predicate / per-domain breakdowns, the batch plan, and a deterministic sample of matched names with their matched-defect evidence. Emitted by 'sn run --campaign <spec> --dry-run' and reviewed by a human before a live campaign mutates any accepted docs. This is a point-in-time RUN OUTPUT, not a durable provenance record: it describes the graph as it stood at generated_at, and the predicates it names may be retired by later work, so a manifest is only valid against the codebase and graph of its own moment.

kind.description: File-kind discriminator, so the artifact is self-identifying alongside its sn_sources / sn_names siblings.

schema_version.description: Manifest format version. Loaders reject unknown versions.

spec.description: The raw defect-predicate selector as the user typed it (e.g. 'prose:typical_values,audit:latex' or 'all').

spec_describe.description: Human-readable expansion of the spec, for the reviewer who did not type it.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the manifest was built. The selection reflects the graph at this instant only.

total.description: Number of accepted names the spec selected (after any pilot reduction).

per_predicate.description: Selected-name count per matched predicate key ('prose:<class>', 'audit', 'audit:<substr>', 'quarantined'). A name matching several predicates is counted under each, so these need not sum to total.

per_domain.description: Selected-name count per physics domain; names with no domain are grouped under '(none)'. Sums to total.

quarantined_count.description: How many selected names are currently quarantined (validation_status='quarantined').

batch_plan.description: How the selection will be split for budgeted, gated draining.

n_batches.description: Number of batches the selection splits into (the last may be short).

sample.description: Deterministic random sample of selected names with their matched-defect evidence — what the reviewer actually reads to judge whether the spec selected the right work. Seeded, so a dry run and the live run it authorizes agree.

name.description: The standard name (falls back to the id).

matched_predicates.description: Predicate key -> the evidence strings that matched it (a banned-prose match count, the audit check names that fired, or the quarantine reason).

quarantined.description: Whether this name is currently quarantined.

physics_domain.description: The name's physics domain; empty string when it has none.

pilot.description: Present only when the selection was reduced to a deterministic stratified pilot. Absent for a full-selection manifest.

from_total.description: Size of the full selection the pilot was drawn from.
